{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species, dropping rows with missing flipper_length_mm
mean_flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species', as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort by mean flipper length in descending order
mean_flipper_by_species = mean_flipper_by_species.sort_values('flipper_length_mm', ascending=False)

# Extract the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_species = mean_flipper_by_species.iloc[0]['species']

# Print results
print(mean_flipper_by_species)
print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_species}')"}
